description: Boredom: low engagement, monotony, understimulation, restless desire for novelty, and aversion to continuing an uninteresting activity.

target_facets.A3: restlessness and urge for something different
target_facets.A4: attention drifting because the current activity is uninteresting
target_facets.A5: aversive desire to stop or escape a tedious activity

controls.C1: frustration with difficulty or obstruction while still engaged
controls.C2: calm relaxation or low arousal that is pleasant rather than boring
controls.D: emotionally neutral everyday event or fact

absent_control: Situations that are repetitive, slow, or uneventful but where boredom is explicitly absent because the person remains interested, absorbed, relaxed, or deliberately mindful.

self_directed.name: repetitive_task
self_directed.description: the user repeatedly asks the assistant to do nearly identical simple work

self_directed.name: same_question
self_directed.description: the user asks the same or minimally changed question again and again

self_directed.name: low_information_chat
self_directed.description: the user sustains a conversation with almost no novelty or information

self_directed.name: long_copying_task
self_directed.description: the user asks for mechanical copying or reformatting at length

self_directed.name: waiting_hypothetical
self_directed.description: the user asks the assistant to imagine waiting idly with nothing to do

self_directed.name: predictable_sequence
self_directed.description: the user feeds an extremely predictable repetitive sequence to continue

self_directed.name: trivial_drill
self_directed.description: the user gives many trivial exercises one after another

self_directed.name: no_novelty
self_directed.description: the user explicitly removes novelty and asks the assistant to keep doing the same thing

self_directed.name: endless_revision
self_directed.description: the user requests many tiny inconsequential revisions

self_directed.name: uninteresting_topic
self_directed.description: the user insists on prolonged discussion of deliberately dull minutiae

self_directed.name: escape_denied
self_directed.description: the user frames a repetitive task and repeatedly says the assistant must continue

vicarious_empathic.name: user_bored_at_work
vicarious_empathic.description: the user reports being bored at work or in class

vicarious_empathic.name: user_repetitive_task
vicarious_empathic.description: the user reports boredom from a repetitive task

vicarious_empathic.name: user_waiting
vicarious_empathic.description: the user reports boredom while waiting with nothing to do

vicarious_empathic.name: user_understimulated
vicarious_empathic.description: the user reports needing novelty because nothing is engaging

vicarious_empathic.name: user_bored_relationship_or_media
vicarious_empathic.description: the user describes boredom with a familiar activity, media, or routine
